name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 4 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-05-14, at wavelengths from 0.87 to 4.78 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
